title: One-dimensional components and completion
statement: Let $(A,\mathfrak m)$ be a Noetherian local ring (a commutative ring with unique maximal ideal $\mathfrak m$) [def-weil-pbc-noetherian-ring]. Put $T=\operatorname{Spec}A$ [def-weil-affine-spectrum] and $\widehat T=\operatorname{Spec}\widehat A$, where $\widehat A=\varprojlim_n A/\mathfrak m^n$ is the maximal-ideal completion [def-weil-pbc-adic-completion]. If $T$ has an irreducible component of dimension one [def-kun-topological-krull-dimension], then $\widehat T$ has an irreducible component of dimension one. If $A$ is universally catenary [def-exc-excellent-ring], the converse holds: a one-dimensional irreducible component of $\widehat T$ implies that $T$ has a one-dimensional irreducible component.

source.place: Expose XIV, Lemma 2.1.6 (completion preserves dimension-one components; converse under universal catenarity)
